rule: Use the released retained participant set; do not impose an additional tracking-ratio exclusion
rationale: Preserves the public release as supplied while still reporting trial-level missingness/validity. The release itself already reflects upstream exclusions and manual correction decisions.
The SRL descriptor explicitly reports excluding recordings below 80%. Reproduce only at the level supported by released metadata; do not silently reinterpret a recording-level rule as trial-level.
The release exposes per-stimulus tracking ratio. Applying 80% at trial level is a separate sensitivity rule, not assumed to be identical to the authors' recording-level exclusion.

rule: Threshold determined from prespecified missingness/recovery simulation for between-AOI transition count
rationale: Modern data-quality guidance recommends exclusion standards tied to the measurement requirement. The calibration simulation must be independent of the focal Prompt-vs-Non-prompt effect and its acceptable recovery-error criterion must be fixed before estimating focal branches.
